analysis_refs.heading: 2. Twenty categories and how to find candidates for each
analysis_refs.text: | C10 Courses, lecture notes and teaching materials | Open-education consortium members, university OpenCourseWare directories and OER hubs | NPTEL, SWAYAM, IIT/university course portals and teacher-education institutions | Course catalogs/feeds with stable lesson IDs; separate free learning material from paid certificates/enrollment conditions |

analysis_refs.heading: C10 — Courses, lecture notes and teaching materials
analysis_refs.text:
For India, [SWAYAM's official overview](https://swayam.gov.in/about) identifies
national coordinators including NPTEL, UGC, CEC, NCERT, NIOS and IGNOU. Follow
coordinator → participating institution → official course/lesson catalog.
Record the producer institution and distribution platform separately. SWAYAM
describes free course learning and paid certification exams; the destination's
actual learning-access conditions still need review.

analysis_refs.heading: Permission or supported-integration clarification — 5
analysis_refs.text: | [SWAYAM](https://swayam.gov.in/terms_of_use) | Current terms prohibit scraping/bulk download; no external catalog API verified. | Ask SWAYAM for an expressly permitted metadata API/export or integration agreement. A learner login does not remove the scraping restriction. Owner action: permission/integration request advisable. |

analysis_refs.heading: Technical failure or unfinished research — 44
analysis_refs.text: For the two explicit broad method restrictions: SWAYAM prohibits scraping/bulk downloads; OpenCity’s saved terms prohibit automated retrieval/indexing and its API route is disallowed. An ordinary user account does not override those terms. A written exception or explicitly permitted integration would be a separate basis.
